newsitem.title: UK: Kingsbury shares fall after profits warning.
newsitem.headline: Kingsbury shares fall after profits warning.

text.p: Shares in furniture and carpet retailer Kingsbury Group Plc fell sharply on Monday after the company warned that 1996 profits would be well below expectations.
The shares lost 27 percent, or 82p to be trading at 217-1/2p by 1237 GMT, their lowest level since April last year.
In an interim trading update Kingsbury said 1996 profits are expected to be ahead of last year's 4.06 million stg but would be "well below current market expectations."
Analysts had been expecting profits of around 6.0 million stg.
The company said it expected to raise the final dividend to not less than 2.5p per share, a 25 percent increase on last year.
Kingsbury said the extension of its interest free credit offer and a delay in the rise of customer orders had impacted on the group's profitability. Annual results are scheduled for March 25.
